title: Decode One Instruction — 2026-09-12 (Windows x86-64)
blurb:
Challenge: Decode this instruction (Intel syntax), byte by byte:

4A 8B 04 63

Give the mnemonic and full operands.

Answer: mov rax, qword ptr [rbx + r12*2]

4A is REX 0100 1010 (W=1 for 64-bit operands, X=1, B=0); 8B is MOV r64, r/m64. ModRM 04 = 00 000 100: mod=00 (no displacement), reg=000 (RAX, destination), rm=100 (SIB-follows escape). SIB 63 = 01 100 011: scale=01 (x2), index=100, base=011 (RBX) -- an index of 100 would normally mean 'no index,' but REX.X=1 extends that field to 1100 = R12, selecting it as a real scaled index register rather than the sentinel.
